# SC8103: undeclared-resource-use

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for undeclared resource use. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Correct the `@InfraResource` declaration or the module/command/job resource use. Declare each logical resource once, reference only declared resources, and keep operations within `read | write | publish | consume`.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC8103` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC8103
@InfraResource({ name: "orders-db", kind: "database" })
class OrdersDatabase {}
@Command({
  name: "orders.create",
  permission: "orders.create",
  uses: [{ resource: OrdersDatabase, operations: ["write"] }],
})
class CreateOrderCommand {}
@Module({ name: "orders", commands: [CreateOrderCommand] })
class OrdersModule {}
```
